summary: Round-2 feature testing (Google Auth, Push, Voice, Bus Timings, Community Feed, Business Editor). Backend: 15/15 new pytest cases pass (all round-2 endpoints working correctly through the public URL). No MongoDB _id leaks in any response. Frontend: Onboarding, Home (all 8 quick-actions incl. updates->/feed, home-search-submit now present, bus-card-0 renders), Feed (loads with broadcast post), /post/new sign-in card with post-signin-btn, Settings (all testIDs present, TE toggle re-renders UI in Telugu), Employee login + edit (wrong code -> 401, correct code -> /employee/edit with all fields, save PUTs successfully, logout returns to /(tabs)). Deprecated 'shadow*' style-prop warnings still present.

integration_issues.issue: Spec expects Alert dialog when tapping feed-new-post FAB while signed out. Actual behaviour: FAB navigates to /post/new which then shows a 'Sign in to post to the feed' card + post-signin-btn. Functionally equivalent (user is prompted to sign in) but no native Alert() is triggered. Consider aligning implementation with spec or updating spec.

Tapping employee-edit-save PUTs successfully (backend returns 200) but no visible success Alert or toast appeared in the automation run. UI stays on the edit screen. Recommend showing a success confirmation for user feedback.

issues: Iteration 1 finding: Telugu glyphs on the branded Welcome title still render with visible character gaps / broken conjuncts on web preview. Bundle Noto Sans Telugu via expo-font.

react_native_issues.issue: React Native Web deprecation warning repeated: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — migrate shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to boxShadow (or use Platform.select). Reference: various components across app (multiple stylesheets).

Warning: 'Listening to push token changes is not yet fully supported on web. Adding a listener will have no effect.' — expected on web preview; consider guarding the push-token listener with Platform.OS !== 'web' in /app/frontend/src/push.ts to silence the warning. Live push will only work on a real native build.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Trigger a native Alert.alert('Sign in required',...) in feed.tsx when a signed-out user taps feed-new-post FAB, per spec — or accept current /post/new route as the sign-in prompt.
Show a success Alert or toast after successful save in /employee/edit for user feedback.
Migrate 'shadow*' style props to 'boxShadow' (or Platform.select) to silence RN Web deprecation warnings.
Guard push listener with Platform.OS !== 'web' in src/push.ts to remove noisy web warnings.
Bundle Noto Sans Telugu via expo-font and apply to Welcome onboarding title (carry-over from iteration 1).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /buses returns non-negative eta_min via wrap-around (eta += 24*60 if <0). Verified.
server.py: /business/{id}/edit-login uses seeded edit_code derived from sha1(business_id) % 1_000_000 (formula matches memory/test_credentials.md). DO NOT change formula.
server.py: All responses use PROJECTION={_id:0}. No _id leaks in any tested endpoint.
server.py: /voice/transcribe correctly rejects empty body with 400 and doesn't 404/500 on garbage bytes (502 from Whisper on non-audio).
server.py: /register-push tolerates placeholder EMERGENT_PUSH_KEY (401 upstream is logged and ignored) and returns 201.
server.py: /posts/{id}/report has a stray '$set: {hidden_if: True}' side-effect that writes an unused field — likely a typo, should be removed or renamed to 'hidden' logic. Not blocking.
server.py: biz_edit_tokens TTL index is on 'expires_at'; verified expired tokens are rejected in _require_edit_token even before Mongo TTL sweeps.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (2 minor integration deviations; all testIDs present)

seed_data_creation: TEST_Broadcast update inserted via /api/announcements/broadcast during backend tests (visible in /feed as 'Official update · TEST_Broadcast'). Consider clearing before demo.
